dissonance.dress_shine_vs_grey.description: Vibrant dress stands out against grey laboratory space
dissonance.dress_shine_vs_grey.contents: Vibrant cool dress stands out against grey laboratory walls. Saturated colors create clear visual contrast. Cool aqua, pink, lavender catch overhead light.

dissonance.precious_vs_laboratory.description: Elaborate dress in utilitarian institutional setting
dissonance.precious_vs_laboratory.contents: Couture dress in grey laboratory facility. Celebration dress in non-celebratory space. Festive aesthetic versus functional facility.

dissonance.beauty_vs_breakdown.description: Perfect appearance contrasts with visible physical condition
dissonance.beauty_vs_breakdown.contents: Meticulous styling and heavy makeup visible alongside tired eyes, hollow cheeks, unwell expression. Detailed dress with embellishments contrasts with visible physical condition. Preparation visible alongside fatigue.

dissonance.celebration_vs_extraction.contents: Celebration dress clashes with laboratory facility. Equipment and laboratory details visible. Festive attire in institutional setting.

dissonance.pose_strain_visible.description: Body positioned with visible physical strain
dissonance.pose_strain_visible.contents: Pose held but already degrading. Position drifting from where it was placed. Physical fatigue in positioning.
